notes.title: 🎉 5th Anniversary Major Update + Community Items Unlocked!
notes.notes:
Dear Art & Puzzle Lovers,
We’re celebrating 5 amazing years of WORLD OF ART – JIGSAW PUZZLES on Steam with our most significant update yet!
[hr][/hr]✨ What's New in the Major Update:
✅ Enhanced gameplay experience based on community feedback

✅ Improved interface and refined visuals

✅ All DLC content revised and upgraded

✅ General performance improvements and polish

Whether you're a returning fan or a new puzzle enthusiast, now’s the perfect time to experience the peaceful world of art through puzzles.
[hr][/hr]🏆 GREAT NEWS: Community Items Are Here!
We’re proud to announce that WORLD OF ART – JIGSAW PUZZLES now features Steam Community Items, including:

🎨 Collectible Trading Cards

🖼️ Beautiful Profile Backgrounds

💬 Unique Emoticons

🏅 Craftable Badges

These are just the beginning of a new chapter — and we’d love to hear your thoughts!

👉 Join the discussion and share your feedback in the Community Hub:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1303670/discussions/0/601914224408619027/

🙏 Thank You, Community

Your reviews, suggestions, and continued passion for the game have helped shape every puzzle and improvement. This update is a tribute to you.

From all of us at WORLD OF ART – thank you for being part of this artistic journey.

🧩 Let’s keep building something beautiful, one piece at a time.

notes.title: WORLD OF ART - a Major Update continues
notes.notes:
WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES
Major Updates shaped by your feedback, ideas, and support

Dear Fellow Jigsaw Puzzlers,
This major update is based directly on your reviews, posts, and suggestions – along with a few new ideas developed over time. Every improvement is designed with the intention to make WORLD OF ART – JIGSAW PUZZLES more enjoyable, fair, and flexible for your preferred way of playing.

🎯 Points System Improved
One of the most important change is completely revised points system, now more accurate and rewarding – especially for players who enjoy large or more challenging puzzles and PixelArt by Numbers.

This updated system applies not only to the main game, but also to:
✔️ 3D DLC
✔️ Jigstris Mode
✔️ PixelArt by Numbers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/fc76573782182078c6144f507a769510cdcd0534.png

🖼️ WORLD OF ART – Main Game
🧩 12 pieces – 1 point
🧩 48 pieces – 7 points
🧩 108 pieces – 25 points
🧩 300 pieces – 150 points

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/5ebc7def322d954f1ffd35198321801faeaacb1f.png

🧠 JIGSTRIS
🧩 12 pieces – 1 point
🧩 48 pieces – 10 points
🧩 108 pieces – 30 points
🧩 300 pieces – 170 points

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/a26eea45b1e6bdea83ba0fb292b104ce6726f384.png

🎨 PIXELART by NUMBERS
Easy
🧩 32 – 170 pts
🧩 64 – 240 pts
🧩 128 – 360 pts
Normal
🧩 32 – 700 pts
🧩 64 – 900 pts
🧩 128 – 1200 pts
Hard
🧩 32 – 2000 pts
🧩 64 – 3000 pts
🧩 128 – 4000 pts

Sounds good?

🎨 Visual Options & Interface Improvements
    Background selection – choose colors and seasonal particle effects.
    Optional shadows – added for better piece visibility.
    General polish to the interface for a more refined experience.

🧱 3D DLC – New Features
    Optional frame and grid tools added, based on user requests.
    Ability to grab and move multiple pieces at once.
    Customization and performance options for smoother play on a variety of systems.

🔧 Technical Fixes
    Various bug fixes, UI refinements, and performance improvements.

🖼️ More Puzzles Added
    Over 100 paintings in the main game for free.
    Over 130 additional puzzles in Upcoming packages coming soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/552848095fde31c2f6aa0022b2dd364e89dc89ae.jpg

💬 Share Your Thoughts
If you find the new system useful, or if something still feels off – feel free to share it. Feedback continues to shape each update and helps guide the direction of future improvements.

⭐ Support Through Reviews ⭐

WORLD OF ART is approaching its 5th anniversary this June, and the next seasonal update will celebrate that milestone.
If you’ve enjoyed the game so far, consider leaving a Steam review.

Reaching 500 reviews will unlock the next steps:
Achievements, trading cards, and collectibles can be added – but only with your continued support.

Thank you for being part of WORLD OF ART – and for helping it grow with every piece you place.

notes.title: WORLD OF ART - A MAJOR UPDATE and DISCOUNT - AUTUMN, WINTER and SPRING 2025!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

There has been a gap in recent updates, caused by serious issues and bumps along the road of independent game development.
Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES is back!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37838639/08c41f7c864a807673b025d02955837fac57c89b.jpg

The upcoming Spring 2025 Major Update is much bigger than usual.
It includes many new paintings—Autumn, Winter, and Spring 2025, all in one!
There are also new options, features, fixes, and 4 DLCs coming soon.

The base version of the gallery will exceed 1600 paintings, and the DLCs will bring few hundreds more!
This means a few hundred new puzzles for you to enjoy!


WORLD OF ART needs your support more than ever. If you enjoy the game, please help us grow by:

     Wishing us on Steam
     Following WORLD OF ART JIGSAW PUZZLES
     Sharing with friends or family who might love the game
     Leaving a review if you haven't already—your feedback means the world!

Every action helps us as independent developers, and your support makes a huge difference!

Check out my other games and upcoming titles:

    The Chess
    The Trial
    SOLCIALISTS
    Project SWARM: DSEP
     ...and a secret FPP project to be revealed soon! 😎

Enjoy the update, thanks again for your support!
All the best!


Which season’s puzzles are you most excited to see—Autumn, Winter, or Spring? Let me know in the comments!
